A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoViP research and provide readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–H. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched without material comparison gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original captioning and downstream diagnostic results, ablations, benchmark evaluations, and a human study with 21 participants.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results and the human study, including the supplementary evaluations in its appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix C retain the same recognition and retrieval rewards, GSPO training, degeneration filtering, and caption-augmented generation. No algorithm, architecture, objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: The captioning benchmark, LSD/LAR/ITR diagnostics, personalization benchmarks, multi-image benchmarks, and caption-quality evaluations are retained. The multi-image coverage summarized in v3 Table 4 already appeared in v2 Table S.3.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain the same GPT, Gemini, Qwen, RAP, and RePIC comparators. Appendix algorithm and distilled-SFT comparisons also match. The changed GPT citation does not document a newly evaluated model.

E3.justification: Both retain the 2.8K/1.3K captioning train/test sizes, 500 diagnostic contexts, evaluation metrics, decoding settings, and 21-participant study with 276 judgments. The relocated DOCCI evaluation still uses 3,000 images.

E4.justification: The reward, training-algorithm, concept-count, prompt-role, and RL-versus-SFT ablations remain unchanged. Recognition-versus-retrieval analysis, visual robustness examples, and caption-preservation checks are also retained; relocation introduces no new analyses.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version adds seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the existing preference proportions and regression summaries are retained.

E6.justification: Matched tables and figures retain their results. CoViP positive accuracies remain 77.4/68.4/65.2/59.7 in Table 2, and CAG diagnostic scores remain 58.2/49.2/42.8 in Table 3. Relocated benchmark and appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(7), Algorithm 1, and Equations (S.1)–(S.7) preserve the same definitions and mathematical formulations. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added, removed, or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: contextualized visual personalization, captioning-based RL and CAG, diagnostic evaluation, and downstream generalization. Abstract wording edits and promotion of existing benchmark evidence do not change these claims.

C2.justification: Section 7 changes the proposed future extension from on-device, privacy-preserving benchmarks to omnimodal benchmarks including conversational voice recordings. Existing interpretations of retrieval gains and the synthetic-data, textual-noise, and visual-robustness limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices C, D, and H retain the implementation settings, model identifiers, filtering thresholds, and prompt templates. Project and code access information is unchanged; v3 prints the same project URL already hyperlinked in v2.

R1.justification: v3 adds OmniPersona (Oh et al., 2026) to motivate omnimodal future work and replaces the GPT-5 system-card citation with a GPT-5.1 announcement. The substantive positioning against prior personalization methods otherwise remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 reorganizes Section 6, replaces numbered discussion subsections with paragraph headings, moves caption-quality discussion to Appendix G, and removes repeated LAR rationale from Appendix D. Abstract, affiliation, and publication information receive limited edits; most prose remains unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 Tables 4–6 become v3 Tables S.7–S.9, while v2 Table S.3 becomes v3 Table 4. Figures 4 and 5 exchange order, several displays are resized or relocated, and some captions and headers change. The underlying graphics and results are retained.

improvement.justification: The revision preserves the methods, evidence, and principal conclusions while mainly redistributing existing material. Removing repeated LAR prose improves concision, but v3 introduces small editorial inconsistencies: Section 3.2.2 points to Appendix F for human evaluation, and the GPT-5 citation refers to GPT-5.1. These localized changes do not materially alter overall paper quality.
